Requisition Number: 8207

Position:  Registered Respiratory Therapist

Status:  Full Time

Number of Vacancies: 7

Department:  Respiratory Therapy

Role Level: Allied Health AH10.5 $44.49 to $57.79 per hour

Site: Mississauga Hospital (The successful candidate may be scheduled or reassigned to any THP site based on operational needs)

Work Model: On-Site

Hours of Work/Shifts:  Days/Nights (12 Hour Shifts, Weekends and Statutory Holidays)

Posted: October 20, 2026

Internal Deadline: October 27, 2026
 

Trillium Health Partners is one of Canada’s largest community-based teaching hospitals, serving the growing and diverse populations of Mississauga, West Toronto, and surrounding communities through the Credit Valley Hospital, the Mississauga Hospital, the Queensway Health Centre, the Reactivation care Centre (Church Site) and the new THP-UHN Reactivation Care Centre. Guided by our values of compassion, excellence, and courage, and through our strategic roadmap, Plan to 2030, we are creating a new kind of health care - defined not by illness, but by the health and well-being of people and communities.

Position Summary

Reporting to a Clinical Manager, the ideal candidate will be focused on providing excellent patient centered care in a dynamic environment where he/she will be given the opportunity to deliver care with compassion, excellence and courage.

Job Description:

The Registered Respiratory Therapist specializes in the delivery of evidence-based cardio-respiratory interventions. Their practice is based on an in-depth knowledge of critical care gained through education and clinical experience. They work with inter-professional teams in the ICU, Emergency, Medicine Units, Labor and Delivery and NICU settings to advance their practices, improve patient outcomes and provide clinical expertise to effect system-wide changes to improve program of care. They will monitor and manage metrics designed at improving THP standards of practice and care – to help pioneer and bring THP to the forefront of cutting edge Respiratory Therapy care in Canada. They will work both autonomously and in collaboration with other healthcare professionals holding influence over three main domains: safe patient care, excellence in practice and the healthcare system.

Responsibilities:       

  • Ensures safe provision of cardio-respiratory care.

  • Works with all patient populations (e.g. Adult, pediatric and neonatal).

  • Acts as a mentor, role model and expert resource for patient respiratory care to the all staff within the inter-professional program team.

  • Provide and assist with educational outreach initiatives within THP.

  • Supports academic teaching by providing/sharing knowledge with patients, families, RT students and other health care professionals.

  • Models professionalism and lifelong learning through participation in continuing education and research initiatives.

  • In collaboration with the RT Clinical Educator, the RRT provides leadership in order to ensure appropriate orientation of new staff.

  • Works with adult, pediatric, and neonatal:

    • Intubate/extubate

    • Insert arterial punctures/arterial line

    • Conduct patient assessment

    • Patient transport (internal and external)

    • Perform respiratory therapeutics and diagnostics

  • Member of the Critical Care Rapid Response Teams.

  • Member of the Cardiac Arrest Team.

 

Qualifications:

  • Excellent knowledge of RT practice.

  • Excellent knowledge of critical and complex patient populations and related pathologies as well as current knowledge of the most recent technological advancements in respiratory care.

  • Superior critical thinking, enhanced conflict resolution, and the ability to collaborate inter-professionally with a wide variety of health care disciplines.

  • Member in good standing with no limitations with the College of Respiratory Therapists of Ontario.

  • Member in good standing with C.S.R.T. and/or R.T.S.O.

  • BCLS, ACLS, and NRP required.

  • PALS preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in health related field preferred.

  • Two (2) years current critical care experience would be a definite asset.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills required.

  • Ability to work various shifts as required.

  • Positive work and attendance record is essential.

  • Evidence of on-going professional development.

  • Specialty training in other applied areas would be an asset – e.g. research, leadership, quality improvement.

  • Understanding of use of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.

 

To pursue this career opportunity, please visit our website: www.trilliumhealthpartners.ca

 

Internal Candidates who believe they possess the necessary qualifications and experience for this position and who have been in their current position for at least six (6) months are encouraged to apply.
